# Configuration catalog

Every setting reportal reads, in one place: the environment variable, the
`reportal.toml` key, the default in force and what reads it. Resolution is
first match wins (environment, then the workspace table), so a value in both
places is the environment's. `reportal config` prints the same rows resolved
for this workspace; `reportal doctor` reports the ones that are set wrong.

A setting with no workspace key can only come from the environment or its
default. A secret is listed with no default value: its value is never
returned, only its presence and length.

## Environment only

| Setting | Environment | Workspace key | Kind | Default | What it is |
|---------|-------------|---------------|------|---------|------------|
| `billing.provider` | `REPORTAL_BILLING_PROVIDER` |  | text | `auto (Stripe when a secret key is set, else disabled)` | which provider takes a self-serve subscription payment |
| `billing.public_base_url` | `REPORTAL_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` |  | text | `http://127.0.0.1:8002` | the externally reachable base URL a checkout returns the customer to |
| `billing.stripe_api_version` | `REPORTAL_STRIPE_API_VERSION` |  | text | `2026-08-26.dahlia` | the Stripe API version every request pins |
| `billing.stripe_price_analyst` | `REPORTAL_STRIPE_PRICE_ANALYST` |  | text | `none; checkout for this plan answers 503` | the Stripe price id checkout uses for the Analyst plan |
| `billing.stripe_price_enterprise` | `REPORTAL_STRIPE_PRICE_ENTERPRISE` |  | text | `none; checkout for this plan answers 503` | the Stripe price id checkout uses for the Enterprise plan |
| `billing.stripe_price_team` | `REPORTAL_STRIPE_PRICE_TEAM` |  | text | `none; checkout for this plan answers 503` | the Stripe price id checkout uses for the Team plan |
| `billing.stripe_secret_key` | `REPORTAL_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` |  | secret | `none, so billing stays disabled` | the Stripe secret key checkout and portal calls authenticate with |
| `billing.stripe_webhook_secret` | `REPORTAL_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` |  | secret | `none, so every webhook is refused` | the signing secret every incoming webhook is verified against |
| `client.server` | `REPORTAL_SERVER` |  | text | `the --server value` | the portal base URL the customer CLI calls |
| `client.token` | `REPORTAL_TOKEN` |  | secret | `not set` | the API token the customer CLI sends as a bearer |
| `docs.directory` | `REPORTAL_DOCS` |  | path | `the shipped manual, else the workspace's docs/` | the directory the in-app documentation is read from |
| `flirt.sigs_dir` | `REPORTAL_FLIRT_SIGS_DIR` |  | path | `unset, so the FLIRT routes report an empty catalog` | the FLIRT signature checkout the catalog indexes, and the only path it reads |
| `jobs.pool` | `REPORTAL_JOBS_POOL` |  | flag | `on` | the bounded background pool that drains the job queue in this process |

## [auth]

| Setting | Environment | Workspace key | Kind | Default | What it is |
|---------|-------------|---------------|------|---------|------------|
| `auth.required` | `REPORTAL_AUTH` | `[auth] required` | flag | `off` | put every /api route behind an Authorization bearer token |

## [debug]

| Setting | Environment | Workspace key | Kind | Default | What it is |
|---------|-------------|---------------|------|---------|------------|
| `debug.backend` | `REPORTAL_DEBUG_BACKEND` | `[debug] backend` | text | `the first installed backend` | the debug backend a session uses |
| `debug.enabled` | `REPORTAL_DEBUG` | `[debug] enabled` | flag | `off` | allow read-only debug sessions under an installed backend |

## [deployment]

| Setting | Environment | Workspace key | Kind | Default | What it is |
|---------|-------------|---------------|------|---------|------------|
| `deployment.profile` | `REPORTAL_PROFILE` | `[deployment] profile` | text | `personal` | which product this install is: personal (single operator) or saas (multi-tenant) |

## [external]

| Setting | Environment | Workspace key | Kind | Default | What it is |
|---------|-------------|---------------|------|---------|------------|
| `external.allow_remote` | `REPORTAL_ALLOW_EXTERNAL` | `[external] allow_remote` | flag | `off` | allow the remote external sources (a pulled answer leaves the host) |
| `external.virustotal_api_key` | `REPORTAL_VIRUSTOTAL_KEY` | `[external] virustotal_api_key` | secret | `not set` | the VirusTotal key a remote source pull uses |

## [knowledge]

| Setting | Environment | Workspace key | Kind | Default | What it is |
|---------|-------------|---------------|------|---------|------------|
| `knowledge.allow_remote` | `REPORTAL_ALLOW_REMOTE_INGEST` | `[knowledge] allow_remote` | flag | `off` | allow guarded URL ingestion to fetch a URL the caller names |
| `knowledge.cognee_dataset` | `REPORTAL_COGNEE_DATASET` | `[knowledge] cognee_dataset` | text | `reportal` | the dataset the Cognee graph backend writes to |
| `knowledge.graph_backend` | `REPORTAL_GRAPH_BACKEND` | `[knowledge] graph_backend` | text | `sqlite` | the backend a graph sync defaults to |

## [llm]

| Setting | Environment | Workspace key | Kind | Default | What it is |
|---------|-------------|---------------|------|---------|------------|
| `llm.api_key` | `REPORTAL_LLM_API_KEY` | `[llm] api_key` | secret | `not set` | the key sent as a bearer token to that endpoint |
| `llm.endpoint` | `REPORTAL_LLM_ENDPOINT` | `[llm] endpoint` | text | `unset, so the AI extras are off` | the OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint the AI extras call |
| `llm.model` | `REPORTAL_LLM_MODEL` | `[llm] model` | text | `gpt-4o-mini` | the model name sent with every AI request, read once an endpoint is set |

## [pipeline]

| Setting | Environment | Workspace key | Kind | Default | What it is |
|---------|-------------|---------------|------|---------|------------|
| `pipeline.disabled` |  | `[pipeline] disabled` | list | `none` | AI decompilation components a run leaves out |

## [portal]

| Setting | Environment | Workspace key | Kind | Default | What it is |
|---------|-------------|---------------|------|---------|------------|
| `database.path` | `REPORTAL_DB` | `[portal] db` | path | `<workspace>/reportal.db` | the workspace SQLite database every read and write goes through |

## [sandbox]

| Setting | Environment | Workspace key | Kind | Default | What it is |
|---------|-------------|---------------|------|---------|------------|
| `sandbox.enabled` | `REPORTAL_SANDBOX` | `[sandbox] enabled` | flag | `off` | allow detonation of a stored sample under an installed runner |
| `sandbox.runner` | `REPORTAL_SANDBOX_RUNNER` | `[sandbox] runner` | text | `the first installed runner` | the sandbox runner a detonation uses |
